subject: SIG v1.8: request for re-answers and diff vs v1.7
message_1_subject: Request: SIG v1.8 re-answers and diff against v1.7
message_1_body:
Hi Marissa,

As part of our procurement refresh we've moved to the SIG v1.8 template. Could Redwood provide re-answered responses for v1.8 and a side-by-side diff against the v1.7 answers you previously provided? Our compliance team needs to understand any substantive control changes.

Timeline: we'd like the draft back by the end of next week (EOD 2026-03-11) if possible.

Attached is the vendor copy of SIG v1.8. Please confirm an owner and ETA. Also flag any questions that need an archived artifact (e.g., policy docs, screenshots, certificates).

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinPay

Attachment: FinPay_SIG_v1.8_template.xlsx
message_2_subject: Re: Request: SIG v1.8 re-answers and diff against v1.7
message_2_body:
Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up. We'll own this from Redwood. I've looped in Rishi (controls) and Dev (evidence/attachments).

Plan:
- We'll produce a completed SIG v1.8 spreadsheet and a CSV diff (v1.7 -> v1.8)
- Draft ETA: 2026-03-08, final by 2026-03-11 if you need additional artifacts

Quick question: are you primarily focused on control-answer deltas (N/Y) or also on rationale/notes changes? That will affect whether we include expanded justifications.

I'll post the drive link when the draft is ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
message_3_subject: Internal: SIG v1.8 - plan + who owns answers
message_3_body:
Marissa / Dev — quick internal plan:
- I'll take Access Controls, Identity, Encryption, Incident Response (sections 2–5).
- Dev: Change Management, Backup/Recovery, Logical/Physical controls (sections 6–9) + gather evidence artifacts.
- Grace: run a line-level diff between v1.7 answers (our last submission) and the new v1.8 template; output CSV with three columns (QID, v1.7_ans, v1.8_ans).

Evidence needed: SOC2 Type II 2025 PDF (latest), KMS key policy excerpt, SSO/MFA config screenshot, any recent change-approval tickets (Jira keys) for 2025. If any controls changed since our SOC2 period, flag as "new evidence required".

I'll start drafting short rationales for any N->Y or Y->N flips. Target internal review 2026-03-07.

-Rishi
Head of Security Assurance
redwoodinference
message_4_body:
Marissa / Rishi — attached are the deliverables: SIG_v1.8_redwood_answers.xlsx and SIG_v1.8_diff.csv. Also attached SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf.

Notes: most answers are identical to our v1.7 submission. We had one substantive answer change: Q3.4 (data retention: backups) was updated from 'No' to 'Yes' because we now retain encrypted backups for 90 days — rationale and retention policy excerpt included in the Answers sheet. I flagged that row in the diff CSV (column 'change_type' = 'answer_flip').

Action items for Marissa: please share the Drive link and the CSV with FinPay. If they want timestamped artifacts for Q3.4 (backup job run logs or backup policy approval), I can pull the audit snapshot (Jira KB-4123 and S3 lifecycle policy) — will need an NDA for raw logs if they ask.

Attachments: SIG_v1.8_redwood_answers.xlsx; SIG_v1.8_diff.csv; SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Platform Security Engineer
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
message_5_subject: Re: Completed: SIG v1.8 answers + diff (attached)
message_5_body:
Received — thank you. I reviewed the diff and the Q3.4 flip is noted. A couple quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you provide timestamped evidence for the backup retention change (job run snapshot or S3 lifecycle policy with timestamps)? We don't need raw logs unless necessary; a signed policy excerpt + screenshot with UTC timestamp would suffice.

2) Please share a DocuSign link for the amendment to our data handling annex (we'll attach the updated clause referencing the retention change).

If it's easier to walk through the diff, we can do a 30-minute call early next week — otherwise the two artifacts above will let our team close the loop.

Thanks again — Elena
Director, Vendor Risk Management
FinPay
